name: PDF Reader
description: Extracts the text of every PDF file in a folder, one record per page, with the file name and page number. Optionally writes a .txt file beside each PDF.
introductoryText:
![PDF Reader](data:image/png;base64,)

Reads the text layer of PDF files, one record per page: File, Page, Pages (in that file) and Extracted text.

**How to set it up**: choose a folder in **Folder path** (or a single PDF file). Every file whose name ends in .pdf is read, in name order; tick **Include subfolders** to read those too. Tick **Extract to TXT files** to also save each PDF's text as a .txt file of the same name beside it.

Files that can't be read (damaged, or protected with a password) are skipped and named in the block's message. Scanned documents with no text layer give pages with empty text: the block does not do OCR. Follow it with formula or text blocks to pick values (an invoice number, a total) out of the text.

options.name: folderPath
options.title: Folder path
options.description: The folder of PDF files to read, on the Omniscope server, or a single PDF file.

options.name: recursive
options.title: Include subfolders
options.description: Also read PDF files in subfolders; the File field then holds the path from the chosen folder.

options.name: writeTxt
options.title: Extract to TXT files
options.description: Also save each PDF's text as a .txt file with the same name, beside the PDF (an existing .txt of that name is replaced). Needs write access to the folder.
